argumentList:
set -euo pipefail; export KEV_MERGE=1; export KEV_DTYPE='float16'; command=$(printf '%s' 'Y2QgL2hvbWUvZ29sZGVuL2tldiAmJiAuL3ZlbnYvYmluL3B5dGhvbiBzZXJ2ZS5weSAtLXBvcnQgMTg5OTY=' | base64 -d); setsid bash -lc "exec $command" & child=$!; start=$(awk '{print $22}' "/proc/$child/stat"); printf 'REDCOMPUTE_KEV_PROCESS=%s:%s
